decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation line adds to the firm's established laser portfolio at low marginal cost. Its web visibility is still limited, so its value remains uncertain, and keeping the option open is cheap while a sibling cabin product is being positioned.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits at the core of the business and pulls through recurring consumables revenue. It costs little to keep and has shown no negative signal that would justify abandoning it.

The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal model by covering different surfaces and applications, which fits the strategy of matching technology to each application. Keeping it is cheap and the evidence so far is not negative.
The industrial laser marking line is shown on the home page as the firm's flagship and direction. The firm is committing further to this option, not abandoning it.
The compact laser cabin was only recently launched and promoted on a page of its own. Its prospects are still unresolved and it builds on shared laser technology, so the option is worth holding.
The lubricant printing system won a trade fair award, a positive signal of its value in sheet metal processing. Its niche specialization makes continued low-cost exploration worthwhile.
